sessions.phase_label: Video-ad scoping, pilot production, review, and revision

requirements.title: Campaign Conversion Objective
requirements.definition: The ads must prioritize lead-generating conversion performance, with the client's desired campaign outcome being a cost per lead below ₹80 rather than merely improved aesthetics.
requirements.boundary_note: This captures the campaign-level acceptance objective; hooks, pacing, messaging, and visual style remain separate implementation behaviors.

requirements.title: Landing-Page and Tracking Audit
requirements.definition: Diagnose the click-to-landing-page drop-off and Quality Ranking issue and provide implementation recommendations for the landing page or tracking configuration.
requirements.boundary_note: This was a distinct audit workstream accepted for quotation and later explicitly removed; it is independent of video production.

requirements.title: Pilot Video Package
requirements.definition: Deliver an initial pilot of three 45-second video ads, each exported in 9:16 and 4:5 formats, with five additional creatives contemplated only after successful pilot testing.
requirements.boundary_note: Video count, duration, aspect-ratio exports, and conditional expansion are attributes of one deliverable package rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Production Input Sourcing
requirements.definition: The freelancer must originate the script, production footage or generated scenes, and voiceover rather than relying on client-supplied raw footage or voiceover.
requirements.boundary_note: This covers responsibility for sourcing production inputs; the required content, language, visual method, and technical quality are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Distinct Creative Angles
requirements.definition: Each creative in the multi-ad campaign should test a distinct psychological angle or scenario rather than repeating one undifferentiated concept.
requirements.boundary_note: This governs diversity between ads and is separate from the changing creative direction applied to an individual ad.

requirements.title: Realistic Visual Generation Method
requirements.definition: Create realistic, native-looking scenes without avatars or static-image animation, using believable movement, environments, and product interaction so the output does not appear obviously AI-generated.
requirements.boundary_note: This combines the selected scene-generation method with its core realism acceptance criterion; casting, lip sync, and product inclusion can change or fail independently.

requirements.title: Lip Sync and Facial Performance
requirements.definition: Dialogue scenes must use accurate lip sync and natural facial expressions.
requirements.boundary_note: Lip synchronization has its own observable acceptance criterion and can fail independently of overall visual realism or audio mixing.

requirements.title: Target Audience Alignment
requirements.definition: Tailor the creative and script to the product's Indian audience, primarily people aged 28–54.
requirements.boundary_note: This governs audience targeting; the actors' nationality and gender are represented separately as casting constraints.

requirements.title: Testimonial Material
requirements.definition: Create suitable testimonial-style material independently because the client's existing customer reviews are not available in a usable recorded format.
requirements.boundary_note: This covers creation of testimonial material, while the broader decision between an original concept and reference adaptation belongs to the creative-direction Requirement.

requirements.title: Direct Opening Hook
requirements.definition: Open each ad with a strong, direct, market-appropriate hook that captures attention within approximately the first three seconds.
requirements.boundary_note: Hook wording and immediacy can be evaluated independently from later pacing, cuts, and the broader script message.

requirements.title: Retention-Focused Editing
requirements.definition: Use fast pacing, smooth transitions, and strategically timed cuts to sustain viewer attention and correct the static pacing seen in the unsuccessful reference.
requirements.boundary_note: Cut timing and pacing are independently testable editing behaviors and are not merged with hook wording or audio levels.

requirements.title: Professional Audio Mixing
requirements.definition: Mix voiceover, background music, and sound effects at an appropriate, consistent level for social-media playback, including the client's stated Audio DB 18 criterion.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the audio-level and sound-design acceptance mechanism; voiceover language and lip synchronization remain separate.

requirements.title: Indian Actor Casting
requirements.definition: Only Indian actors should appear in the video, with male actors preferred where suitable.
requirements.boundary_note: Actor identity and preference can change independently of audience age, scene-generation method, or script language.

requirements.title: Viral and Engaging Creative Style
requirements.definition: The creative must feel engaging, appealing, and capable of standing out as viral-style Meta content rather than appearing boring, generic, or commonplace.
requirements.boundary_note: This captures the client's repeated style acceptance criterion; conversion outcome, visual realism, and hook construction remain independently evaluable.

requirements.title: Creative Concept Direction
requirements.definition: Govern whether the ad uses an original testimonial concept or an improved adaptation of the client's latest successful reference while featuring the client's product.
requirements.boundary_note: The concept's originality-versus-adaptation choice evolves independently from exact keywords, language, product coverage, and technical production quality.

requirements.title: Mobile-Optimized Subtitles
requirements.definition: Include professional subtitles formatted for clear mobile viewing.
requirements.boundary_note: Subtitle rendering is an independently verifiable output behavior rather than an attribute of script language or audio mixing.

requirements.title: Integrated Call to Action
requirements.definition: Integrate a clear call to action naturally into the ad.
requirements.boundary_note: The call to action is a distinct script and edit element that can be changed without altering the rest of the messaging.

requirements.title: Final Technical Finish
requirements.definition: Apply color grading and final polish so the completed ads have professional, broadcast-ready output quality without material defects.
requirements.boundary_note: This covers final technical finish and delivery quality, not the separate realism, editing, audio, or campaign-performance criteria.

requirements.title: Reference-Aligned Product Messaging
requirements.definition: Build the script from the latest reference and winning ad's effective message, benefits, keywords, and pain points; avoid relying only on generic terms, preserve the intended message with stronger wording, and omit the prohibited word लिंग.
requirements.boundary_note: Approved keywords, prohibited wording, benefits, and message fidelity form one script-content mechanism; language and overall concept direction can evolve separately.

requirements.title: Hindi Localization
requirements.definition: Provide the complete script, dialogue, and review material in Hindi rather than English.
requirements.boundary_note: Language localization is independently changeable and verifiable; it is separate from the selected keywords and underlying product message.

requirements.title: Visual Preview Approval Workflow
requirements.definition: Provide a short Hindi preview containing visuals and dialogue for client review before completing the full 45-second production.
requirements.boundary_note: The preview is an independently requested review artifact; its target duration is an attribute rather than a separate Requirement.

requirements.title: Two-Product Presentation
requirements.definition: Show both client products in the video, using the supplied imagery for the first product and AI-refined pack shots where needed for the second product.
requirements.boundary_note: This governs which products appear and how missing product imagery is produced; whether diabetes is explicitly used as a narrative theme remains discretionary in the supplied evidence.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I am only interested in an expert who can deliver a winning creative capable of keeping my cpl below 80inr; being able to explain why the 3rd one is not performing would show that you can create such a winning creative.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Several points became clear after I reviewed the data.

Against a target of ₹80, the current cost per lead is ₹132.80, which puts the account 66% above goal. The breakdown, however, indicates that creative is not the only problem.

The ad is attracting attention effectively, as shown by a genuinely strong Link CTR of 6.82%. The larger leak occurs after the click: just 72.4% of link clicks register as landing-page views, so approximately 28% of paid clicks disappear before the page loads or tracking records them. That points to page speed or tracking configuration rather than video quality, and creative changes alone cannot correct it.

Another important signal is that Quality Ranking is Below Average, in the bottom 35%, even though Engagement Rate and Conversion Rate are both Above Average. This combination usually suggests that the ad or landing-page experience may be generating negative signals, such as hidden ads or reports, while people who do click continue to convert well. If it is left unresolved, those signals can quietly raise CPMs throughout the account regardless of the next creative's strength.

To reach ₹80 CPL rather than merely produce a better video, I would prioritize the following:

1\. Rebuild the creative around the structural rules proven by the winner, using faster cuts, corrected audio levels, a proper hook, and delivery in 9:16 and 4:5
2\. Review landing-page load speed and the pixel/tracking configuration, because the 28% drop-off is consuming budget independently of the ad. If useful, I can inspect this directly; tracking and funnel problems are part of the automation side of my work, not only video
3\. After the fix, continue monitoring Quality Ranking, since that metric will show whether the negative-feedback problem is being resolved

If you agree with this direction, I can prepare a quote and timeline for the creative rebuild. I can also include a note covering the landing-page fix if you want me to handle that work, so let me know and I will send everything over.

execution.observed_behavior: Campaign data showed a current cost per lead of ₹132.80, which was 66% above the ₹80 target.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Before I award the work, please provide a complete written description of everything you will do. Confirm that the ad will use actual footage and that neither an avatar nor a static image will be used to create the video. The specification should also cover every other technical step you will handle, including proper lipsync.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Before moving forward, I want to resolve one important distinction so our expectations match.

Although I agree that AI avatars and static-image animation should be avoided, traditional live-action footage is not part of the workflow I am proposing either. The alternative is to create AI-generated scenes designed to resemble authentic handheld UGC.

This approach offers greater creative flexibility while still supporting realistic human movement, natural interaction with the product, proper lip sync, and a consistent visual treatment. The goal is for the finished creative to feel native to Instagram, not obviously AI-generated.

Production Workflow

- Build realistic AI video scenes without using avatars or static-image animation.

- Design natural handheld-style shots with believable environments and product handling.

- Where dialogue appears, apply accurate lip sync together with natural facial expressions.

- Shape the edit around a strong hook, fast-paced cuts, captions, sound design, and a CTA optimized for short-form performance.

- Refine and color grade the output until it has a polished but organic UGC look.

For production, I will need the following from you:

- High-resolution product images captured from multiple angles.

- Images of the packaging, including the front, back, and inside where applicable.

- Your logo and any available brand guidelines.

- Information from your product page or landing page.

- The main product benefits, along with any messaging or compliance rules that must be followed.

If footage shot with a real camera by a person is a strict requirement, I want to be transparent that this proposal will not meet it. My process relies on highly realistic AI-generated scenes optimized for creative testing rather than live-action filming.

ambiguity.description: The client requested actual footage, while the freelancer states that the proposed workflow excludes live-action footage and instead uses realistic AI-generated scenes. The client has not yet explicitly resolved this production-method conflict.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Nikhil Rao,

The first draft is attached for your review. It took a little longer than expected because I did not want to rush the work; both the visuals and voiceover needed to come together in an engaging, natural, and scroll-stopping way while remaining true to your reference style.

I also found that forcing the story into exactly 16 seconds made it feel rushed. To give the emotions, product reveal, and voiceover enough space, I extended the draft slightly to 22 seconds. I believe the added room creates a stronger, more natural viewing experience without losing the impact of a short-form ad.

Please share your feedback. I am happy to refine anything you would like changed, and I remain fully committed to making sure the final production satisfies you and achieves the outcome you envision.
